About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.

What you'll do
• 
Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results
• 
Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption
• 
Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams
• 
Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account
• 
Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship
• 
Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap
• 
Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts
• 
Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

Requirements
• 
5+ years of product management experience, with recent experience owning enterprise or B2B product
• 
A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers
• 
Experience shipping enterprise capabilities such as admin, permissions, billing, or security, and driving adoption across large customer accounts
• 
Deep familiarity with how creative, marketing, and media teams work, and a habit of bringing customer insights into every product decision
• 
Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end
• 
Experience working directly with sales and customers and turning a high volume of requests into a clear, prioritized roadmap
• 
Design-minded, with a high bar for product quality and the ability to mock up concepts and workflows yourself
• 
Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs
• 
Strong product judgment and a clear point of view on what to build and why
• 
A bias toward shipping and iterating over long alignment cycles
• 
Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

Headquarters: Tampa, Florida USA
 
URL: https://www.elementalclaims.com

We are looking for a confident, highly fluent English-speaking Appointment Setter to join our public adjusting firm.

We work with homeowners throughout the United States who may need assistance filing and navigating property insurance claims. Your primary responsibility will be communicating with potential clients who have already responded to our outreach.

You will use our proven system to answer text messages, qualify interested homeowners, make calls when necessary, and schedule appointments for our field representatives/public adjusters.

What you'll be doing:

• Responding to homeowners who engage with our outreach regarding potential property insurance claims
• Speaking with homeowners who may need assistance filing an insurance claim for damage to their property
• Calling interested or potentially interested homeowners when needed
• Following our existing scripts and proven appointment-setting system
• Answering basic questions and handling objections naturally
• Qualifying potential clients and identifying homeowners who may have a valid reason to file a property insurance claim
• Scheduling qualified appointments for our field representatives/public adjusters
• Updating leads and appointments inside our CRM

Who we're looking for:

Near native American spoken English is REQUIRED.

We are specifically looking for someone who is extremely comfortable communicating with American customers and understands U.S. conversational culture. You should be able to have a natural conversation rather than simply read from a script.

You do NOT need to live in the United States.

Experience working with U.S. customers is strongly preferred. Previous experience in appointment setting, outbound sales, call centers, roofing, insurance, public adjusting, real estate, home improvement, or other U.S. home-service industries is a major plus.

You should be:

• Confident on the phone
• Persuasive without being overly aggressive
• Comfortable handling objections
• Reliable and consistent
• Comfortable using a CRM and learning new software
• Able to follow a system while still sounding natural
• Available during U.S. business hours

Compensation:

This position offers a $1,000 monthly base salary plus performance-based commission.

In addition to the base salary, you will earn $200 for every lead that results in a signed client.

Our performance expectation is approximately 10 signed clients per month. At that level, compensation would be:

• Base Salary: $1,000/month
• 10 Signed Clients × $200: $2,000 commission
• Expected Total Monthly Compensation: $3,000

There is no set limit on commission—the more qualified leads you convert into signed clients, the more you can earn.

We provide the leads, systems, scripts, and workflow. Your responsibility is to communicate with homeowners, identify and qualify potential clients who may need assistance with a property insurance claim, and consistently generate quality appointments that our in-person representatives will work to convert into signed clients.

IMPORTANT — Please include the following with your application:

Along with your résumé and a brief description of your relevant experience, please submit a 2–4 minute audio or video recording speaking in English.

In your recording:

• 

Introduce yourself.

• 

Tell us where you're currently located.

• 

Describe your previous sales, appointment-setting, insurance, or U.S. customer-service experience.

• 

Tell us about the types of American customers you've communicated with.

• 

Explain why you believe you'd be successful in this position.

APPLICATIONS SENT WITHOUT A VOICE OR VIDEO RECORDING WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED

Please speak naturally. Do not read a prepared script. We are evaluating communication ability, confidence, conversational English, and overall customer-facing presence.

Candidates who perform well will be invited to a short interview.

We're looking for people who want to become long-term members of our team. As our operation grows, there will be opportunities for our strongest performers to take on additional responsibilities.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elemental-claims-llc-appointment-setter-inside-sales
